title: Coefficient bounds for the Euclidean covector norm (Simon 6.1.15)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let α be a k-covector on ℝ^P (α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) k, a continuous alternating k-linear form). Write e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 (l ∈ Fin P) for the standard basis of ℝ^P, e_J := (e_{J(0)}, …, e_{J(k−1)}) for J : Fin k → Fin P, and |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{J : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing} α(e_J)²)^{1/2}. Then: (i) |α(e_I)| ≤ |α| for every strictly increasing I : Fin k → Fin P; (ii) for every strictly increasing ι : Fin (k+1) → Fin P, Σ_{i ∈ Fin (k+1)} α(e_{ι(i.succAbove 0)}, …, e_{ι(i.succAbove (k−1))})² ≤ |α|², where i.succAbove : Fin k → Fin (k+1) is the increasing enumeration of Fin (k+1) ∖ {i}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) k), (∀ I : Fin k → Fin P, StrictMono I → |α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (I j) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∀ ι : Fin (k + 1) → Fin P, StrictMono ι → ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι (i.succAbove j)) (1 : ℝ))) ^ 2 ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α ^ 2
